headline: 🔴 CISA orders NetScaler patch by Saturday, 🏛️ Qilin claims ATF breach, 💾 SQL Server 2019 CVE exploited in wild, 🤖 AI middleware platforms LiteLLM/RAGFlow/Kestra targeted, 🕵️ Aurora affiliate uses Cursor AI for attack planning, 🇷🇺 Russia-linked OAuth phishing hits academics
summary: CISA added Citrix NetScaler CVE-2026-8452 to KEV with a binding Saturday deadline after watchTowr demonstrated RCE beyond Citrix's initial DoS assessment. Qilin ransomware claimed the ATF in a multi-victim campaign. A 2019 Microsoft SQL Server RCE is actively exploited. AI infrastructure platforms LiteLLM, RAGFlow, and Kestra are targeted for credential theft. An Aurora affiliate's exposed data shows AI-assisted attack planning. Russia-linked clusters conduct coordinated OAuth phishing against US and European academics.
